Made-up Lemon Test Chicken

Made-up Lemon Test Chicken

A made-up recipe written for Gluttony's tests.

Chicken

  • 500 g chicken thighs
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 2 cloves garlic minced

Sauce

  • 1 cup chicken stock
  • 1/2 tsp salt

Chicken

  • Brown the chicken in the oil.
  • Add the garlic and cook briefly.

Sauce

  • Pour in the stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
